summary: Craft completed before implementation. The UX is shaped as a calm care itinerary organized by verified family situations, with a committed deep-green/gold brand system, Bodoni Moda and Source Sans 3 typography, decisively cropped low-saturation first-party caregiver imagery, a light-to-neutral-to-green color evolution, and a mobile-native assessment path. Business claims remain bounded to prospect.json, PRODUCT.md, and BRAND_SOURCE.md.
